question: On Passage — No Funds for Repeat Child Care Violations Act (H R 7726)
bill_title: Stop Child Care Scams Act of 2026
plain_language: This bill subjects states to additional sanctions for improperly using funds under the Child Care and Development Block Grant program. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Recommit — No Funds for Repeat Child Care Violations Act (H R 7726)
bill_title: Stop Child Care Scams Act of 2026
plain_language: H.R. 7726 (Stop Child Care Scams Act of 2026) subjects states to additional sanctions for improperly using funds under the Child Care and Development Block Grant program. A motion to recommit is the minority's last formal chance to send a bill back to committee before the passage vote. A Yea supports sending it back; a Nay keeps it on the floor for the passage vote.

question: On Passage — Supporting Pregnant and Parenting Women and Families Act (H R 6945)
bill_title: Supporting Pregnant and Parenting Women and Families Act
plain_language: This bill provides statutory authority for states to use Temporary Assistance for Needy Families funds for pregnancy centers that, in the summary's words, “support protecting the life of the mother and the unborn child” and that offer services such as counseling, pregnancy testing, prenatal education, and material supports. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.
